R2: it must use official template or include at least three years of documented revision history. R3: a Tier‑1 venue presentation is allowed only if it occurred more than eighteen months before the deadline; eighteen months does not qualify. R4: an earlier Meridian acceptance blocks handling unless five years have passed; five years is acceptable. R5: a paired submission may contain two manuscripts; each must meet R1 and R2, and at least one must satisfy R3. R6: Track D papers are exempt from R2 but must carry two endorsements; one endorsement is insufficient and does not affect any other rule. R7: any manuscript with an open retraction notice is automatically rejected, overriding all other rules including R9. R8: figure count must be between eight and forty‑five inclusive; paired submissions may have up to seventy figures. R9: if a paper fails R8 only by having too few figures, it is padded to the minimum and receives PADDED; exceeding maximum causes RETURNED. R10: a prior‑round withdrawal does not count as an acceptance for R4 but resets the R3 venue clock to withdrawal date. Verdicts are HANDLED (all rules satisfied), RETURNED (rule failed) or PADDED (R9 case when only the minimum shortfall occurs and no other rule is broken).
